LanguageData.QEverything.Workbench.SearchHelp: Search by item name, internal name or mod.
LanguageData.QEverything.Workbench.ClearHelp: Clear the search and filters to see more.
LanguageData.QEverything.Workbench.FocusHelp: Click an item to see what quality does for it.\n\nClick a value in the table to change it for that item. A * marks an item exception: a setting made for that one item.
LanguageData.QEverything.Workbench.Conflict: Two categories at the same level disagree, so Off wins.
LanguageData.QEverything.Workbench.UseRule: Follow its group or category (no exception)
LanguageData.QEverything.Workbench.UseRemovalRule: Follow its group or category (no exception)
LanguageData.QEverything.Workbench.UnavailableHelp: The mod that adds this item is not loaded. Its exceptions are kept in case the mod comes back.
LanguageData.QEverything.Workbench.VanillaHelp: This item has quality in the base game. You can keep it or remove it. Removing needs a restart and existing quality levels can be lost.
LanguageData.QEverything.Workbench.QualityHelp: Whether this kind of item has a quality level. "Built in" means the base game or another mod already gives it quality.
LanguageData.QEverything.Workbench.EffectsHelp: Whether this mod's quality effects may apply to the item. An effect also has to be switched on in the Effects tab and has to fit the item. Click an item to see which ones apply.
LanguageData.QEverything.Workbench.PriceHelp: Whether quality raises or lowers the item's market value.
LanguageData.QEverything.Workbench.SummaryNoQuality: This item has no quality, so quality effects and pricing don't apply to it.
LanguageData.QEverything.Workbench.SummaryEffectsOff: This item has quality, but quality effects are switched off for it.
LanguageData.QEverything.Workbench.SummaryNoEffects: This item has quality, but no quality effect that fits it is switched on.
LanguageData.QEverything.Workbench.SummaryEffects: This item has quality. Effects that apply ({0}): {1}.
